changelog:
Version 2.1.9

- Tightened permissions: Skill now explicitly declares allowed Bash tool use.
- Installation and update instructions now require explicit user approval before installing/updating the PersonWise CLI.
- Clarified that switching to a different PersonWise market/service may only occur at the explicit request of the user.
- Attribution block skill_version updated to 2.1.9.
- Skill will handle course-creation requests outside the default Product First-Success Guide workflow only when the user explicitly asks.
- Removed deprecated skill-card.md file.
summary: Turn setup guides into an askable digital-human quick-start course.
